id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description: The specification used for retrieving data displayed by the graph.

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

hiddenRegions.description: A list of hidden region ids.

activeNodePopover.description: The component that is rendered when a node is clicked.

activeTooltip.description: Holds the data to be displayed in the graph's tooltip.

backgroundColor.description: The background color of the chart canvas. Defaults to {@link UiSdlThemeTemplate#componentBackgroundColor}.

cacheKey.description: The cache key of the whole in-memory graph. See {@link InMemoryGraph#m_cacheKey}.

clearable.description:
Whether or not graph should be clearable.
If set to true, a button is rendered on the canvas that the user can click to clear the graph.

isClearingCanvasItems.description:
Whether the clearing of canvas items is in progress.
This field is used to determine whether the clear graph warning modal component should show up.
See usage of this field in `SDLGraphVisualization.jsx` for more details.

combineConfig.description: The config for controlling when the nodes should combine into groups.

dispatchRealtimeTimebarAction.description:
Boolean to config if timebar should dispatch setTimeBarInRangeItemsAction or not for each change.
Default is true, meaning each time timebar moves, it will dispatch the action.
When false, no action will dispatch during timebar play,
and one action will dispatch to update redux when timebar finishes animation.

Usage: Developer should leave this as is if no performance slowdown with timebar animation.
If animating large dataset with timebar shows lagging, turn this off to improve animation performance.
WARNING: turn this boolean off WILL cause redux store to go out of sync with component during animation.

mapboxStyle.description: Mapbox Style that will be used to call the API and get a styled map

mapboxVersion.description: Mapbox API version that's used with the style label to be able to retrieve the proper styles.

data.description: Holds the data to display in the graph.

canvasItems.description:
Holds the data that appears on the canvas.  Cloned from props.data.  This is the state that will be updated when
the graph on the canvas changes, for example, hovering or selecting a node.

defaultFitOptionOnSelect.description: The default fit option for the graph when an item is selected.

fitOption.description: The default fit option for the graph when data load.

defaultEdgeColors.description:
A list of default colors used to color edges.

If {@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationEdgeStyleConfig#fillColorByProperty} is of type
{@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationFillColorByPropertyStrategyCategorical}, the component will assign a color to each
category from here in order.

The colors have to belong to {@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationFillColorOption}.

defaultNodeColors.description:
A list of default colors used to color nodes.

If {@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationNodeStyleConfig#fillColorByProperty} is of type
{@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationFillColorByPropertyStrategyCategorical}, the component will assign a color to each
category from here in order.

The colors have to belong to {@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationFillColorOption}.

disableMergedEdges.description:
By default, all edges between two nodes are merged into a single edge.
Set this to true to disable merged edges.

emptyState.description:
The component that handles the empty state.
It will appear if the grid has no data.
Empty state is only availible if {@link showMap} is false

endSpacing.description: Defaults to tight, loose will put a little space between the node and the edge.

geoJsonDataSpec.description: The specification used for retrieving GeoJSON data passed on to Leaflet to be rendered in the tile layer.

geoJsonData.description:
Holds the data passed to Leaflet to display on the tile layer on the map. Needs to be in the GeoJSON format:
https://leafletjs.com/examples/geojson/

shapeData.description:
Holds draw shape data created by user using the drawing tool
structured as geoJsonData

height.description:
The height in pixels of the graph.  This will be reflected in the height of the container div; the graph
element itself will then take up 100% of the container's height.

highlightedItemIds.description:
The list of highlighted item ids when an item is hovered on or selected. This field is only set if
{@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationHoverConfig#highlightNeighborsOnHover} or
{@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationSelectionConfig#highlightNeighborsOnSelect} is true.

hoverConfig.description: The configuration to control the appearance and behavior of hovered items.

hoveredEdgeId.description: The id of the currently hovered edge.

hoveredNodeId.description: The id of the currently hovered node.

mergedEdgeConfig.description: The configuration for controlling how to merge multiple links between two nodes.

mergedEdgeMapping.description: A mapping from an original edge id to its merged edge id.

pingConfig.description: Configuration for a temporary animated halo effect to a node or a link, also known as a ping effect.

pingItems.description: An array of node or edge ids to temporarily animate or ping.

resettable.description:
Whether or not graph should be resettable.
If set to true, a button is rendered on the canvas that the user can click to reset the graph.

selectedItems.description:
A dictionary with a truthy property for each selected item.
The keys are the ids of the selected node/edge.

selectedNodeIds.description: An array of node ids which represent selected nodes on the graph canvas.

selectedEdgeIds.description: An array of edge ids which represent selected edges on the graph canvas.

selectionConfig.description: The configuration to control the appearance and behavior of selected items.

selectedRegion.description: The name of the selected GeoJSON region.

showMap.description: Set to true to enable map mode.

showEdgesOnMap.description: Set to true to show edges between nodes when {@link showMap} is `true`.

showLegend.description: When true show the canvas legend.

timeBarConfig.description:
The configuration to control the appearance of the time bar.
Must be configured in order for the time bar to be shown.
Currently the time bar only supports filtering on edge temporal data or node
temporal data. If provided configs for both, it will default to filtering
on edges and ignore node temporal data.

timeBarInRangeItems.description: The items in the currently visible time bar range.

showZoomControls.description:
Whether or not the zoom control buttons should be displayed on this graph.
If set to true, a button group is rendered on the canvas that the user can use zoom in,
zoom out and re-center the graph.
If set to false, the mouse/trackpad gestures still enable the users to zoom in/out.

zoomConfiguration.description: Configuration for the zooming in the graph visualization.

zoomToRegionOnClick.description:
Whether or not clicking on a geoJson region will select the region.
Note, this will only work if {@link showMap} and {@link geoJsonDataSpec#selectable} is true.

allowNodeAnnotations.description: Whether to allow the user to annotate nodes.

exportGraph.description:
Whether or not the graph should be exportable. (Export with geoJson data is not supported)
If set to true, a button is rendered on the canvas that the user can click to export the graph as a PDF.

hiddenNodes.description: A list of hidden nodes ids.

exportFileName.description: The name of the file to be exported when the user clicks the export button.

title: A UI node graph component that displays data in a network graph.
name: UiSdlGraphVisualization
